description: Graded physics questions for facility signal search. Grades: 3 a measurement of the queried quantity; 2 a commanded, reference or setpoint value of it, or the same quantity at an adjacent point; 1 related hardware; 0 read and judged irrelevant.

questions.query: the total plasma current carried by the discharge
questions.intent: a grade-3 signal measures the total toroidal plasma current itself; a programmed or feedback reference waveform of it, or a current in a magnet coil rather than in the plasma, is only grade 2

questions.query: the stored energy of the plasma inferred from magnetic measurements
questions.intent: a grade-3 signal is a measured global plasma stored energy obtained from the diamagnetic flux; a raw diamagnetic loop voltage or surface integral, or an equilibrium-reconstruction estimate rather than the diamagnetic measurement, is only grade 2

questions.query: the amplitude of the toroidal mode number one magnetic fluctuation
questions.intent: a grade-3 signal is a measured amplitude, or its sine or cosine component, of the n=1 toroidal magnetic field fluctuation from Mirnov-type probes; a raw probe signal at an unspecified mode, or an instability detection flag, is only grade 2 or lower

questions.query: soft x-ray emission from the plasma along a viewing chord
questions.intent: a grade-3 signal is a measured soft x-ray emission or intensity along a viewing chord, including filtered photodiode channels; a hard x-ray signal, a bolometric total radiated power, or a camera image of the plasma is only grade 1 or 2

questions.query: the surface temperature of the divertor target tiles measured by infrared thermography
questions.intent: a grade-3 signal is a time series of divertor target tile surface temperature from an infrared camera region of interest; the camera's raw image frame, or a thermocouple in the supporting structure rather than the tile surface, is only grade 2

questions.query: the surface temperature of the inboard first wall panels
questions.intent: a grade-3 signal is a measured surface temperature of a plasma-facing first wall panel; a coolant inlet or outlet temperature of the wall's cooling circuit, or a temperature of a neighbouring structure such as a port plug, is only grade 2

questions.query: the temperature of the vacuum vessel port structures
questions.intent: a grade-3 signal is a measured temperature of a vacuum vessel port structure; a port plug or other in-vessel component temperature is a different structure and grade 2, as is a cooling circuit inlet temperature

questions.query: the vacuum pressure in the cryostat measured by cold cathode gauges
questions.intent: a grade-3 signal is a cold cathode gauge pressure in the cryostat or cryogenic pumping volume, in pascals; a pirani gauge reading at the same location, or the cryoplant's own helium temperature or valve position, is only grade 2

questions.query: the partial pressure of hydrogen isotopes in the vacuum vessel measured with a mass spectrometer
questions.intent: a grade-3 signal is a mass-spectrometer partial pressure, or the ion current or partial pressure ratio from which it is derived, attributed to mass-to-charge ratio one; a valve status or manifold channel on the same spectrometer is only grade 1

questions.query: the flow rate of nitrogen injected into the vacuum vessel for radiative divertor cooling
questions.intent: a grade-3 signal is a measured volumetric nitrogen flow rate at a vacuum vessel inlet used for impurity seeding; an inlet pressure or temperature of the same line, or a deuterium fuelling flow, is only grade 2 or lower

questions.query: the deuterium fuelling flow rate injected into the vacuum vessel
questions.intent: a grade-3 signal is a measured deuterium flow rate delivered through a fuelling line into the vacuum vessel; a gas puff valve command or setpoint, a pressure of the same line, or a plasma density derived from it, is only grade 2 or lower
